title: Use local support cones and operator log instead of an invalid Loewner-power step
statement: For disjoint colored layers, Q(delta)=E_q...E_1 and P=Q*Q>0. With M=sum k^l, the actual reviewed bound is n^-1|logTr exp(-beta H)-logTr P(beta/r)^r|<=2Dr/M[sinh(x)-x]<=D J^3 M^2 exp(x)beta^3/(3r^2), x=JM beta/r. Local support cones and Hermitian-part cancellation give the logarithmic operator bound; operator-monotone log then log-trace-exp Lipschitz avoid illegally raising a Loewner sandwich to powers. No stoquasticity, geometric partition, gap, high-temperature beta restriction or thermodynamic limit is assumed.
